title: Florida workers with criminal records trapped by temp agencies, report finds
summary: Former prisoners feel ‘disposable’ after being driven to accept jobs that often pay lower wages and have no benefitsHundreds of thousandsFloridianworkers with criminal records are driven to accept jobs at temporary staffing agencies, often with lower wages and no benefits, according to a new report.Former prisoners described feeling “disposable” after finding themselves stuck in temporary jobs, unable to obtain direct employment with companies.Continue reading...
